purpose: Teach: おかず/歪み/ぶつかる/硬く/防ぎ/意地悪/ほどほど/足取り

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お弁当のおかず、いつも何入ってる?
lines.en: What do you usually have in your bento sides?
lines.style: Curious, offhand—leaning against something. Warm opener. Not fishing for anything, just wondering aloud. The comfortable kind of question between people who see each other at lunch.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。最近、机の歪みが気になる。
lines.en: Yeah. Actually, I've been noticing the desk is warping lately.
lines.style: Slight pause before the pivot—like he's thinking out loud. Dry observation. Not complaining, just stating a fact he's been sitting with. Quiet matter-of-factness.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 廊下で先輩とぶつかる、ヒヤッとした。
lines.en: I bumped into a senpai in the hallway earlier—scared me half to death.
lines.style: Light, self-aware laugh on the memory. Quick tempo, animated. Eyes wide a little. The retelling of a small fright that's already become funny.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 冬場、空気で唇、硬くなるよね。
lines.en: Your lips get all stiff in the cold air this time of year, don't they?
lines.style: Gentle observation, almost to himself. Slow, measured pace. The kind of thing someone notices when they're paying attention to small details. No urgency.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 風邪を防ぎたいから、マスク忘れずに。
lines.en: Don't forget your mask if you want to stay healthy this winter.
lines.style: Practical, straightforward. A small note of care beneath the directness. Not worried, just looking out. The tone of someone who noticed and is saying it because it matters.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: クラスの意地悪な発言、もう、流そう。
lines.en: Let that mean comment from class go. Don't let it sit with you.
lines.style: Firm but gentle. A small lean forward. The voice of someone offering quiet counsel because they've seen this before. Not preachy—just steady.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 勉強、ほどほどにしないと、燃え尽きる。
lines.en: If you keep pushing that hard with studying, you're going to burn yourself out.
lines.style: Measured, a touch of concern underneath. Not lecturing—sharing something he knows from experience. Slight slowdown on the warning, natural rhythm otherwise.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 部活帰りの足取り、軽くて、嬉しい。
lines.en: My feet felt light walking back after club today—I'm actually happy about that.
lines.style: Warm, small genuine smile in the voice. Lighter pace. A quiet moment of noticing something small and good. The contentment of the last line of a good day.
